name: Supabase Self-Hosted
description: Supabase Self-Hosted packages Postgres, a PostgREST Data API, authentication, storage, realtime, functions, and operational services for customer-operated infrastructure. Its exposed database schemas can contain arbitrary tables, columns, rows, identities, and sensitive application data.
agentUseSummary: Relay calls one fixed PostgREST table query for one preselected row and projects only conventional id and status columns. It accepts only a new-format publishable key mapped to anon, requires minimum column grants and an RLS SELECT policy matching exactly that row, and blocks secret or service-role keys, broader data access, other services, administration, and mutations.

scopes: anon SELECT on selected table id and status only
RLS policy matching selected row only

capabilities.label: Read selected row state
capabilities.description: Read one selected row's ID and status.

allowed.label: Read selected row state
allowed.description: Use one fixed PostgREST request for the selected table and row and return only ID and status.

blocked.label: Expose row data or identities
blocked.description: Columns other than id and status, other rows, auth identities, storage objects, function output, logs, and secrets are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Mutate Supabase
blocked.description: Rows, tables, schemas, SQL, RLS policies, auth, storage, functions, realtime, settings, and every write or administrative action are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad or RLS-bypassing access
blocked.description: Secret keys, service-role keys, database credentials, arbitrary PostgREST queries, other tables or rows, GraphQL, and management endpoints are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Row State Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected row's ID and status; other data, resources, administration, RLS bypass, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Mount one no-input selected-row state reader backed by Railway's bounded Supabase adapter.
Mount one no-input selected-row state reader backed by Railway's bounded Supabase adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized public HTTPS Supabase Self-Hosted staging project must enable new publishable keys and provide a selected public table with conventional id and status columns, anon SELECT grants limited to those columns, an enabled RLS SELECT policy matching one exact row, and Fairfax validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console lane, configure the least-privilege grants and RLS policy, enter the project URL, publishable key, table, and row ID through Relay, then validate exact-row binding, fixed-column projection, secret and service-role key rejection, broader query and adjacent-service denial, mutation denial, redirect and private-DNS denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Official self-hosting documentation defines customer responsibility for operating and securing the single-project Supabase stack.
Official self-hosted authentication documentation defines new publishable and secret key formats, publishable-to-anon gateway routing, PostgREST request headers, and coexistence with legacy keys.
Official Data API security documentation defines minimum Postgres grants and RLS as complementary controls for table and row access.
Official RLS documentation defines anon policies, per-row SELECT predicates, and the RLS-bypassing authority of service keys, supporting Relay's publishable-only boundary.
Official column-level security documentation defines column grants and explicit field selection for restricting exposed columns.
